blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, Philippines — Tingog Party-list Rep. Jude Acidre welcomed President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s signing of a law establishing a government-funded voucher assistance program expanding Filipino students’ access to quality basic education. Marcos signed the Basic Education Voucher Assistance Act, or Republic Act No. 12327, on Friday, Nov. 20, following its passage by Congress. The measure seeks to provide financial assistance to qualified learners, allowing them and their families to choose schools that best address their educational needs and circumstances.
